lines.speaker: KYLE
lines.text: You can't even lift that.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Kyle is right. The bar has forty kilos on it. You weigh forty five.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: But the second he says it... something in your arms goes hot.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: And the bar goes up. Like it's made of paper.

lines.speaker: KYLE
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Because in this world, every time someone tells you you can't... you get stronger.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not a little stronger. A lot.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: And it turns out, people say it all the time.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: In nineteen sixty eight, researchers told teachers that a few random kids in their class were about to bloom.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The kids weren't special. They were picked by chance.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: A year later, on average, those kids had gained more I.Q. points than their classmates.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: It's called the Pygmalion effect. What people expect from you can change what you do.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Except for you, it's flipped.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Day one. You start collecting doubts.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Gym class. Coach Briggs looks at your arms.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Rope climb? You? Not a chance.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Four seconds to the top. The rope snaps.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Your sister bets you can't open the pickle jar.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: You open the lid. And the jar. And part of the counter.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: By Friday, you can lift your dad's car. About fifteen hundred kilos.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The world record deadlift is five hundred and one.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: So you make a list of every doubter in town. And you visit them all.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: But your best source of doubt is the internet.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: You post one video. You, lifting the family fridge.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Fake. Edited. Wires. No way a kid can do that.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Every hater hits like a protein shake.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: By Sunday, you can lift about six thousand kilos. That's an adult elephant.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then a second video goes viral.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Fourteen year old lifts a car. Twelve million views.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: And everything changes. Because now... people believe in you.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: A little kid asks for a photo.

lines.speaker: CROWD
lines.text: You can do anything!

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Your knees buckle.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Your dad hugs you.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: I always knew you could.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: You can't lift your backpack.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Love makes you weak. Literally.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: So you start hiding. From your fans. From your dad.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: You start wanting people to hate you.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: There's only one person who never believed in you. Kyle.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: So every morning, you go and find him.

lines.speaker: THEO
lines.text: Say it.

lines.speaker: KYLE
lines.text: You can't.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Plus two hundred kilos. It's the weirdest friendship in school.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: You even start doing his homework. Just so he'll keep hating you.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: But week by week, Kyle starts watching you.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: He sees you carry Mrs. Patel's groceries up four floors. He sees you fix the swing nobody fixed.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: And one morning, he opens his mouth... and nothing comes out.

lines.speaker: KYLE
lines.text: I can't say it anymore, man.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: He believes in you. It's the worst thing he's ever done to you.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then, on a Tuesday, the old gym catches fire.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: A roof beam comes down across the exit. Your dad is inside.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The whole street is watching. And the whole street believes.

lines.speaker: CROWD
lines.text: You can do it, Theo!

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Every cheer makes you weaker. Your arms shake. The beam won't move.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Two thousand kilos. Eight hundred. Ninety.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: There's one person left.

lines.speaker: THEO
lines.text: Kyle. Please. Tell me I can't.

lines.speaker: KYLE
lines.text: You can't. You never could. You're nothing!

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: He's crying while he says it. He doesn't mean a single word.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: But words are words.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The beam goes up like paper. And your dad walks out.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Later, Kyle sits next to you on the curb.

lines.speaker: KYLE
lines.text: I didn't mean it.

lines.speaker: THEO
lines.text: I know. That's the nicest thing anyone's ever said to me.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Sometimes the people who believe in you most are the ones brave enough to say you can't.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: That night, you look in the mirror. And you realize you've never tried one thing.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: You've never doubted yourself.

lines.speaker: THEO
lines.text: I can't.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The mirror cracks. And every light on the street goes out.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: So, would you want to be strong only when people doubt you? Tell us in the comments.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: And subscribe. Because next time, the whole world says Theo can't.
